clauses.requirement: Every modification of the type of retro-reflective device (the rear retro-reflector of the lamp) shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which approved the type; the Authority may then act as set out in paragraphs 3.4.1.1 and 3.4.1.2 (either consider the modification acceptable or require a further technical service report).

Where a modification of the retro-reflective device type is notified, the Type Approval Authority may consider that the modifications made are unlikely to have an appreciable adverse effect and that in any case the retro-reflective device still meets the requirements; the modified retro-reflector shall in that case still meet the requirements of UN R150.

Where a modification of the retro-reflective device type is notified, the Type Approval Authority may alternatively require a further report from the technical service responsible for conducting the tests; the manufacturer shall provide for such further testing and report if required.

Confirmation or refusal of approval for a modified retro-reflective device type, specifying the alterations, shall be communicated by the procedure specified in paragraph 3.2.2 to the Contracting Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying UN R150.

The Type Approval Authority issuing an extension of approval for a retro-reflective device shall assign a series number to the extension and inform the other Contracting Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying the UN Regulation under which approval was granted by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 1.

Conformity of production procedures for the retro-reflector shall comply with those set out in the 1958 Agreement, Schedule 1 (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), with the requirements of paragraphs 3.5.1 and 3.5.1.1.
Retro-reflectors approved under UN R150 shall be manufactured so as to conform to the approved type by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4 and 5 of the Regulation.
The minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 2 of UN R150 shall be complied with for the retro-reflector.
